h2: Handyman Bali – Small Repairs Sorted in One Visit
intro: A sticking door, a peeling silicone bead, a wobbly shelf – these little issues pile up fast in a tropical villa. As your Handyman Bali contact, I handle all of them in a single visit so you're not juggling multiple trades for minor fixes. From Canggu to Uluwatu, I bring the right tools and parts to get things working again properly.

sections.h3: Why Bali Humidity Wrecks Doors, Screens & Seals
sections.text: The wet season turns untreated timber into a warping machine. Doors that opened fine in March will drag across their frame by June; hinges loosen as the wood swells. Mosquito screens sag when the mesh loses tension in constant moisture, and bathroom silicone blackens within months because spore load stays high year-round. None of these are structural failures – they're climate wear. The fix is usually adjustment, replacement of a hinge pin, or a fresh bead of mould-resistant silicone rather than a full rebuild.

sections.h3: What Your Handyman Bali Visit Actually Includes
sections.text: I come prepared for the most common villa tasks: adjusting sticking doors and replacing worn hinges, swapping locks or handles that have gone loose, re-tensioning or patching mosquito screens, stripping old silicone and re-sealing shower trays and basins, mounting shelves, curtain rails and TVs to brick or blockwork, and assembling flat-pack furniture you've just had delivered. If I spot something else minor while I'm there – a wobbly cabinet door, a dripping tap washer – I'll sort it in the same trip at no extra call-out.

sections.h3: Send Me Photos on WhatsApp Before You Book
sections.text: You don't need to diagnose the problem yourself. A quick photo of the stuck door, the mouldy silicone line, or the shelf bracket that's pulled out of the wall is enough for me to gauge what parts and tools to bring. Mention your area – Canggu, Ubud, Seminyak, Uluwatu, Sanur, Jimbaran, Kuta & Legian, Nusa Dua, Denpasar, Kerobokan or Umalas – so I can plan the route. I'll reply with a rough scope and confirm a time slot right there in the thread.

sections.h3: Small Habits That Keep Repairs Rare
sections.text: A drop of sewing-oil on hinge pins every few months stops most door drag before it starts. Wiping down bathroom glass and silicone after showers cuts the moisture window where mould takes hold. Tightening shelf brackets and TV mounts twice a year prevents slow creep in soft blockwork. And if you notice a mosquito screen starting to sag at one corner, a small patch now saves a full replacement later. None of this takes more than ten minutes, but it stretches the life of fittings dramatically in our climate.

faq.q: Do you cover my villa's location?
faq.a: I work across Canggu, Ubud, Seminyak, Uluwatu, Sanur, Jimbaran, Kuta & Legian, Nusa Dua, Denpasar, Kerobokan and Umalas. If you're just outside that list, send me your address on WhatsApp and I'll let you know whether I can fit you in.

faq.q: How do I get a quote for a repair?
faq.a: The cost depends entirely on what needs doing and which parts are required. Snap a photo or short video of the issue, message it over WhatsApp with your area, and I'll come back with a clear scope so there are no surprises when I arrive.

faq.q: Can I bundle several small jobs into one visit?
faq.a: That's exactly how the service is designed – doors, screens, silicone, shelves, furniture assembly, all sorted in a single trip rather than booking separate trades for each item. Just list everything you'd like addressed in your first WhatsApp message and I'll plan the route around it.
